module_summary: 64-bit UDP transmit framer: an FSM latches parallel UDP/IP header fields, emits the UDP header as one 64-bit word, then forwards length-trimmed payload (tkeep from word count) through a skid-buffer output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, write header word, write payload, payload last, wait last.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input UDP header valid; accepted in IDLE to latch header fields.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready in IDLE when output IP header slot is free.

anchors.name: s_udp_source_port
anchors.why: Representative UDP header input packed directly into first output word.

anchors.name: s_udp_length
anchors.why: UDP length: initializes word count and computes IP length.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input 64-bit UDP payload forwarded after header word.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Input byte enables; checked against remaining count for short frames.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid gating payload transfer and word count.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready from FSM, follows output skid buffer readiness.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker; checks length match and returns FSM to idle.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output IP header valid, set when UDP header accepted.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream IP header ready clears header valid.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output 64-bit IP payload: UDP header word then payload.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid-buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers and early ready.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes; generates last-word tkeep and detects mismatch.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output word mux: header word, payload, or held last word.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tkeep_int
anchors.why: Internal tkeep: full for header, count2keep of remaining bytes at end.

anchors.name: udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched UDP header field used if header word stalls.

anchors.name: m_ip_length_reg
anchors.why: IP length computed as UDP length plus 20; representative IP field.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all parallel header fields.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload word until frame tlast arrives.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating header/payload emission and skid stores.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp data register used when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal word directly into output register.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse: frame shorter than UDP length.

groups.name: Transmit FSM
groups.description: Sequences header latch, header word emission and payload length tracking.

groups.name: Header registers and word mux
groups.description: Latched header fields; UDP fields packed into one 64-bit output word.

groups.name: Payload output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register AXI skid buffer with full-throughput backpressure.
